review_notes.canonical_index: The coordinator's briefing said the new key lands at index two; the builder corrected it to index three and the reviewer confirmed independently with LC_ALL=C sort. Five keys shift, not six, and all of them remain asserted at their new indexes with an exact arity.

review_notes.load_bearing: Reverting the arity from nine to eight drops AUR-403 and AUR-404 to exit 1, and both restore byte-identically.
review_notes.independent_mutation: Eight of the fifty-four mutations were redone against the bytes on disk with the reviewer's own bridge calling all eight validators in a container, outside the builder's harness: an ext transport remote, a credential helper, insteadOf rewriting, a real SCM binary, a look-alike repository root, a submodule, a custom transport and a runtime-assembled credential.
review_notes.reviewer_attacks: Twenty further vectors were blocked, including remote_origin as a leading space, uppercase, an embedded newline and a Cyrillic homoglyph (the pattern anchors with \z rather than multiline), duplicated and uppercased protocol lists, plausible new protocols, extra GIT_ environment variables, a tenth key, an inverted order, duplicated JSON keys and swapping the lock to the image that does carry git with both digests recomputed.
review_notes.probe: Confirmed independently under the real runner flags: the pinned image has no git, upload-pack, receive-pack, ssh, scp, curl, hg, svn, git-lfs or gh, while the go-git image has git 2.39.2 and the network tools. Pinning the bootstrap image makes the denial structural rather than conventional.
review_notes.open_info_findings: The pinned image does carry the busybox wget and nc applets, so the claim of unreachability rests on the denied network and the loopback-only interface rather than on the absence of every network tool; the documented probe should say so. AUR-402 still has no arity or positional assertion, which is pre-existing. The contracts lane of this card deliberately omits registry arity, which is documented and covered three times elsewhere, each proved load bearing.
